title: TRACE RAC code supplement: prospective LLM holdout
description: Companion artifact for the paper Trust Is Not a Score: Runtime Assurance Contracts for High-Risk AI Agents. It contains a prospective synthetic holdout (24 episodes, 72 action attempts) on a protected-branch merge workflow, comparing a Runtime Assurance Contract (RAC) implementation with a separately written full stateful baseline against labels from two blinded LLM judges. Policy, implementations, corpus, and labels are frozen by SHA-256; evaluate.py replays the reported counts byte-identically. All events are synthetic. The original study records are in Ukrainian; English translations of the policy, protocol, judge instructions, and report are in en/.
